Gorakhnath as immortal guru of the Nath panth; Makar Sankranti khichdi fair feeds lakhs and defines Purvanchal pilgrimage.

Classical pilgrimage teaching places Gorakhnath Temple, Gorakhpur within India’s tirtha network: a location where devotion to Guru Gorakhnath (Nath tradition) is believed to ripen vows more readily than in ordinary space. Epic, Puranic, and regional mahatmya literature — not a single uniform text — sustain this sense of sacred geography.
localBeliefs:
In popular pilgrimage memory, Gorakhnath Temple, Gorakhpur is especially associated with Nath peetham · eastern UP mega-search. Guides and elders retell this identity to first-time visitors as the living ‘reason’ the tirtha draws crowds.

Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching at Gorakhnath Temple, Gorakhpur elaborate how Guru Gorakhnath (Nath tradition) blesses devotees who arrive with vows, gratitude, or grief. Festival days intensify these beliefs through processions, special alankara, and community feeding where practised.
